title: Osher path-flux configuration study
lead: One flux family with explicit quadrature-point and integration parameters. Configuration IDs identify experiments, not additional flux methods.
theory_lead: Scheme(flux='osher', quadrature_points=5, integration='gauss') is the default Osher configuration. The point count applies to the whole path for Gauss integration or to each captured panel for sonic-partitioned integration. It is not a spatial reconstruction order.
